title: The Secret to Perfect Masala Dosa 🔥 #shorts
hook: Why does your masala dosa never turn out this crispy?
voiceover_script: Why does your masala dosa never turn out this crispy? Here's what most home cooks get wrong. Start with a well-fermented batter, at least twelve hours, then spread it thin on a screaming hot tawa. Drizzle the edges with ghee, not oil, and let it sit untouched until the edges lift on their own. That's the exact moment it turns golden and shatters like glass. Fill it with spiced potato masala, fold, and serve immediately with coconut chutney and hot sambar. Try this tonight.
